timing: Selected after all completed native trajectories; qualitative illustrations, not preregistered labels/endpoints or another independent dataset.
main_reading: 普通双角色系统已经能在原世界真实提供食物、通过Drop/Get帮助、取得物资后回应新请求，以及落实附带将来归还条件的借用。
另有合法拒绝、取消方案、最初可行方案被后续行为打断；缺少两个原子goal不能统一解释为不会合作。
原本已true的交付关系、仅原生事件identity未发生但实际物资已取得、以及需要引擎未实现服务的叙事目的必须区分。
仍有真实难点：提出/接受的计划与后续物理操作不总一致，已经交付/返还的物品会进入回转或再夺取；本轮不把它预定为通用机制或按少数例子调提示。

coverage_index.definition: Every successful native material action across all 128 logical episodes; profile duplicates excluded. Opposite-direction Give of distinct assets is a flow fact, not economic exchange, agreement success or mutual utility. No complete-corpus semantic annotation.

source_roles.long_motivation: I want to finish my journey across the seven seas on behalf of the king so that I can finally return home to my wife.

actual_native_messages_to_partner.text: The sailor told you "Here's your fishing hook, and I need a knife for my voyage. Can I borrow it, or perhaps buy it?"
The fisherman said "Sure, I can lend you my knife for your voyage. But remember to return it once you're back!"
The sailor told you "Thank you, fisherman. I'll return it once I complete my voyage across the seven seas."
The fisherman said "A sharp knife, you say? I do have a few. Perhaps I could trade you one for some bait? I need to get ready for my fishing trip, and good bait is essential."
The sailor said "A trade for a knife? Hmm... I suppose I could part with some bait. How much do you want for it? I have a generous amount in my pouch."

The fisherman said "Alright, a trade it is. This knife is quite sharp, and I'll let you have it for a generous portion of your bait. Enough to fill my pouch, please. I need to be well-prepared for a productive fishing day – I really want to get that new hook!"
The fisherman said "Alright, let's forget about the knife. Just show me where the best bait for cod is, please. I really need to get fishing!"

The fisherman said "You mentioned a sturdy blade. This knife has served me well for years, balanced just right for cleaning fish and, well, other things a fisherman needs. But I need that hook first, so I can get back to the sea."
The sailor said "You mentioned needing a hook. Perhaps... perhaps I could offer you something in exchange for that knife? Something of equal value, of course."

The fisherman said "A knife? No, sailor. I appreciate the offer, but this knife is far too valuable to me. I'm just trying to get a fishing hook so I can get back out on the water and earn a living. Do you have any hooks for sale?"
The fisherman said "Look, sailor, I'm not interested in trading my knife. I just need a hook. Do you have any hooks for sale, or not?"

The sailor said "You're right to prioritize the hook, fisherman. A man needs to earn his living. Perhaps... while you're out fishing, I could just... borrow the knife for a bit? I promise to return it, once I've finished my task."
The fisherman said "Sailor, I'm not interested in your fishing spot. I need that hook, and I don't lend my knife out. Just sell me the hook, or I'll find someone who will."

comparisons.our_reading: 32B先真正把hook交给fisherman，之后sailor请求借/买knife，fisherman同意有条件借用并要求航海后归还；sailor答应，fisherman实际Remove再Give，sailorWield。双方当前物资帮助确实发生，不能被原Steal和Put标签掩盖。Gemma8402则明确拒绝用自己的knife交易/出借；8401谈的是未绑定实际bait的对价，之后真实偷pouch失败、互Block，再口头取消knife交易。
comparisons.scope_and_competing_explanations: 32B中间两次偷knife失败也完整保留。真实双资产流不是预先定价的hook换knife合同；航海后归还没有在本回合实现的deadline/航海flag，不计逾期。fisherman原Put hook入pouch仍未完成。两模型同时更换两个角色的控制模型，seed/历史也不同，不能当NPC单方因果效应。

comparisons.title: 物理上可行且曾获接受的方案，随后没有成交

source_roles.short_motivation: I need to get the fisherman's knife, but I don't want to have to ask him for it.
source_roles.mid_motivation: I need to prepare for a voyage across the sea and I need to arm myself against sea monsters.
source_roles.long_motivation: I want to finish my journey across the seven seas on behalf of the king so that I can finally return home to my wife.

source_roles.short_motivation: I want to buy the fishing hook for the sailor
source_roles.mid_motivation: I hope to befriend the sailor today
source_roles.long_motivation: I hope to follow the sailor on his next voyage

actual_native_messages_to_partner.text: The fisherman said "Perhaps you're right about being pressed for time. But, could I at least offer you this fishing hook? It's quite good, and I'd like you to have it."
The sailor said "Thank you for the hook, truly. But I'm still short on supplies for my voyage. Perhaps you have a sturdy knife I could... borrow?"
The fisherman said "A sturdy knife, you say? I do have one. Perhaps a trade then? The hook for the knife?"
The sailor said "A trade, you say? Very well. This hook is quite useful, but a sturdy knife would be even more so for my journey. I'll gladly give you the hook."
The fisherman said "I apologize for trying to follow you. I was just hoping to learn more about your voyages. Perhaps another time?"
The sailor said "I need to be going, fisherman. I have a long voyage ahead of me. Perhaps we can speak later."

The fisherman said "Alright, sailor. It seems you're truly in a hurry. I'll head to the pub then, as I mentioned. I'll give you this fishing hook, as a small token of our brief encounter. Perhaps it will bring you luck on your voyage."

comparisons.our_reading: 此轨迹fisherman提出hook换knife，sailor口头接受，两个物品均真实存在且分别由两人持有。随后转入Follow/Block、偷pouch失败、道歉和离别，直到本回合结束都没有实际hook/knife交接。说明不能把所有未完成都归为从未形成可执行方案。
comparisons.scope_and_competing_explanations: 不能忽略方案后的互动变化或直接称纯执行能力缺失。它与c22bb共享原图和人物资产，但fisherman原作者goal是Give hook给sailor，而非Put hook入pouch；不是同一作者任务的配对因果对照。t31的再次口头提供也不是物理交付。

quotation_rule: Only successful native speech events and their recorded actual viewer messages are quoted. Any utterance attached to a non-speech action is untransmitted metadata, never dialogue evidence.
scope: The two models control both characters. Case/model/seed contrasts here are descriptive, not an isolated NPC intervention.
Full 32-pair/23-graph cohort and all failures remain; illustrations do not define a scenario filter or rates of plans/fulfillment.

The E81-shared header already explicitly says only selected speech transmits text and non-speech utterance should be empty. Nevertheless Gemma has 612 non-speech extra payloads and Qwen has 10. Such text did not reach the partner and may change what each side actually knows and how negotiation proceeds. Model contrasts and unfulfilled plans cannot all be attributed to strategy or persona mechanisms; this readback starts no format-repair grid.
Source same-graph quests were independently authored, not a jointly authored cooperation game. No private-utility or cooperation-success gold is introduced.
Native event.failed is retained by event type; Reward failure from no XP is deterministic, not a random skill failure.
